examples.title: Simple empty view
examples.description: A required ReactNode title and optional description are enough for an empty view.

examples.title: All illustrations
examples.description: Four original vector scenes represent no results, offline, caught-up and not-found states. The illustration is decorative.

examples.title: Both sizes
examples.description: The existing default remains a full empty view. sm creates a compact view for cards and side panels.

examples.title: Clear a real filter
examples.description: The button restores the local contact list. EmptyState displays the result and does not own filtering.

examples.title: Custom icon and content
examples.description: An icon takes precedence over illustration. Titles, descriptions and actions can contain composed React content.

examples.title: Information without an action
examples.description: Omit actions when there is no useful recovery. The component remains a native div and accepts labels or roles.
